sloka: अयं महात्मा च महांश्च वीर्यतः समाहितश्चातिसहश्च संयुगे ।असंशयं कर्मगुणोदयादयं सनागयक्षेर्मुनिभिश्च पूजितः ।। ५.४७.२७।।।।
transliteration: ayaṁ mahātmā ca mahāṁśca vīryataḥ samāhitaścātisahaśca saṁyuge ।asaṁśayaṁ karmaguṇodayādayaṁ sanāgayakṣermunibhiśca pūjitaḥ ।। 5.47.27।।।।

translations.english: 'He is a great self. His valour is also admirable. He is focused in battle and highly tolerant. There is no doubt that on account of his excellence even nagas, yakshas and sages offer salutations to him.
translations.hindi: वह यह कि, सुग्रीव न तो देवता हैं, न राक्षस है, न दानव हूँ, न गन्धव हे, न यक्ष हैं प्रौर न पन्नग ही हे
